errors: Modern JVMs generally detect container memory limits automatically; setting MaxRAMPercentage or Xmx is not required for container awareness.
A termination reason of Error with exit code 137 does not rule out an OOM kill; the runtime may not identify every OOM kill as OOMKilled.
A failed liveness probe does not necessarily produce exit code 137: termination normally starts with SIGTERM, with SIGKILL only if the container fails to exit within the grace period.
